title: Newton calculus and stationary profiles of Conway tangles
status: Draft; finite Newton calculus, strict support and stationary profiles proved in one account
imports: Physical crossing and full Hermite derivative identification from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds, Proposition 5.1; enhanced reduced normalization from Theorem 10.1.

The exact turn, trace, colors, positive multiplication, integer supports, primitive lattice, interior maximum and harmonic boundary profiles are proved here. The stronger completed-root leaf bound is retained as a separate specialization. No signed filling or geometric volume theorem is assumed or concluded.
scope: Typesetting, page count and declared imports only; not proof verification.
